text:
Anya: quick question — after the perf run i think we should avoid a global eviction knob and instead add a per-allocation "spill_affinity" hint. opinions?
Matt: +1, hints are safer for incremental rollout. keeps global daemon smaller. :+1:
Kiran: i like hints but we need a clear fallback when hints are ignored by allocator. otherwise tenants could starve.
Anya: proposal sketch below — keep it tiny: 
```
alloc(size, opts={spill_affinity: \"host|cold|none\", reclaim_priority: 0})
free(ptr)
// allocator may treat spill_affinity as a soft preference
```
Matt: minimize surface area — one enum + numeric priority is plenty. don't mirror every policy in API.
Eva: telemetry ask: can we tag allocations with a frag_origin label so we can trace fragmentation regressions later?
Sam: is this compatible with the current KV cache path? offload/restore needs to propagate hint. could be a no-op for cached entries.
Anya: tradeoffs i wrote down:
- pros: per-request opt-in, easy canary, no global policy churn
- cons: pushes decision complexity into placement & increases allocator code paths
Kiran: also think about a soft-reserve token for bulk offload flows to avoid transient OOMs. token could be acquired alongside alloc.
Anya: rollout idea:
1) add API + no-op default behavior
2) implement hint consumer in devruntime (host spill only)
3) enable metrics + canary 10%
4) expand to reclaim policies once metrics look ok
Sam: i'll pick up a prototype for the runtime side, pair with matt for allocator changes.
Matt: ping me Monday, we can sync on allocator model & tests.
build-bot: CI: offload-proto branch -> all checks passed :white_check_mark:
Anya: one more point — fragmentation accounting. instead of per-page counters i'd like to try age-bucketed slab tags + a lightweight sampler for hotset estimation. cheaper and easier to aggregate.
Kiran: sampler looks good, but we need calibration heuristics. also decide sampling rate per-tenant.
Eva: i'll add a dashboard panel for sampler output and frag_origins. helps SRE triage.
Anya: created GH issue #4821 with a rough diagram and a gist: https://gist.github.com/example/frag-sampler-sketch. adding notes to the doc.
Kiran: add migration path for existing metrics so historical dashboards don't break.
Anya: agreed — i'll include a compatibility shim in the RFC. thanks all, i'll file the mini-RFC today and link the prototype PR when ready. :rocket:
